During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[The Crucible|Crucible]] leader [[Chantique]] made her headquarters in a large '''tower''' built on [[Volgax]]. The building was constructed long before the wars, by a [[Extinct Volgax society|society]] that eventually met with extinction.
